locations.aiming: The dish faces northeast toward the barn roof — stand behind the pole, barn on your right shoulder. Do not climb; all work from the ladder step.

devices.label: fx-pole-1 access point (labeled AP-POLE-1 on the unit)
ports: ether1 ← cable from the ground box (this is power + data)
SFP ← empty (do not plug anything here)

devices.label: fx-pole-1 ground box (gray box at pole base)
ports: ether1 → up the pole to AP-POLE-1
ether2 → trench cable toward the house

steps.expected: The AP's power LED turns solid green within 60 seconds.
steps.stop: No LED after 90 seconds — unplug, photograph the ground box LEDs, report.
steps.task: Plug the ground-box ether1 cable into the AP's ether1 port.

steps.expected: The agent confirms the AP appears in neighbors within 5 minutes.
steps.stop: Agent says nothing appears — leave everything plugged in, photograph the AP label, report.
steps.task: Call the agent and read the AP-POLE-1 label serial aloud.

steps.expected: Two bars or better on a phone held at the gate.
steps.stop: No signal at the gate — do not move the dish; photograph the phone screen, report.
steps.task: Walk to the gate and check the FX-NET signal on your phone.

locations.title: Pole 1 — access point swap

locations.aiming: No aiming at this location — everything is indoors. The switch's port 1 LED row faces you when the cupboard door opens.

devices.label: fx-cupboard switch (labeled SW-CUP-1)
ports: ether1 ← cable from the trench (pole side)

steps.expected: Port 1 LED blinks within 30 seconds of plugging.
steps.stop: Port 1 LED stays dark — try the spare cable from the hook once; if still dark, report.
steps.task: Plug the trench cable into switch port ether1.

steps.expected: The agent confirms the pole AP is reachable through the switch.
steps.stop: Agent says unreachable — leave cables as they are, photograph the LED row, report.
steps.task: Call the agent and confirm the pole AP answers.

locations.title: Wiring cupboard — trench cable landing
